This slice changes recipe storage and validation. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or gouge or collision checks. No goldens moved. The safety-tier mutation requirement does not apply. I did not rerun the author's mutations.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_cutting_rows.rs:70`: Exclude recipe rows from the `full` check, as `add_row` now does at line 38. A legal torch can have one recipe for every `WorkMaterial::ALL` entry and no plain material rows. The table hides those recipes at line 113, but the button counts them and disables `Add material row`. The user cannot add a plain row from that editor. Add a UI test that checks the button state for this case. The body acknowledges this defect and defers it to #2663. That other PR is not in this trial merge, so it does not fix this PR's result.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_cutting_rows.rs:113` / PR body: Add before and after screenshots for the changed tool editor. The body has neither image. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body. Do not commit images to the PR branch.

No code, dependency, workflow, build script, or process-file changes were made during this review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. The full-table check now excludes plasma recipes. `torch_material_row_button_counts_plain_rows_only` checks the rendered button state. Recipes for all materials leave the button enabled. Full plain rows disable it. Reverting the filter made the test RED. Restoring it made the test GREEN.
2. The PR body now links the [before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/2681/before.png) and [after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/2681/after.png) screenshots. Both show the same recipe-only editor draft. The images use actual egui output with CPU rendering because no GPU adapter was available. The images are only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. The temporary capture code is removed.

New head: `35b24b75b78426eab02bd59493209f0046bfca4f`.

Validation: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all 13 steps. Clippy passed for tools, app, and UI with all targets and `-D warnings`.

Please re-review this head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 35b24b75b78426eab02bd59493209f0046bfca4f -->
Clean review. This feature can merge at the next cut.

Both findings from the review of `3884fc14f819ff2dc25c0ad4587f0aa3b46a9597` are resolved:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_cutting_rows.rs:70` counts only plain rows. Recipes for every material leave `Add material row` enabled. Full plain rows disable it. `torch_material_row_button_counts_plain_rows_only` passed and checks both states.
2. The body links before and after screenshots on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. I opened both images. They show the button disabled before the fix and enabled after it. The PR changes no PNG files.

The recipe checks, exact-thickness selection, file round trip, and command undo/redo passed. Material-only selection excludes recipes. The decision record states the limits of this slice. `Refs #1521` leaves the remaining work open.
